title: 莎拉·杰西卡·帕克押注培育钻石品牌
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: We want to talk about the stuff that you guys are doing together. But I'm curious how you guys came together.
segments.zh: 我们想聊聊你们合作的项目。但我很好奇你们是怎么走到一起的。

segments.en: Because I'm sure you get pitched a lot of things. I'm sure you get pitched a lot of things.
segments.zh: 因为我相信你肯定收到过很多提议。肯定收到过很多提议。

segments.en: How is it that this kind of made sense?
segments.zh: 这件事是怎么变得合理的？

segments.en: We don't have time to tell each of our own version, but I'm fairly sure they'd be aligned anyway.
segments.zh: 我们没时间各讲各的版本，但我很确定它们会是一致的。

segments.en: I'm just curious where they said what she said that.
segments.zh: 我只是好奇他们是在哪里说她说那话的。

segments.en: I got a call from my agent saying that this young woman had reached out and had started this business,
segments.zh: 我接到经纪人的电话，说这位年轻女士联系了他，并创办了这家企业，

segments.en: although it was not a brand new, newborn. And that she wanted to have a conversation about it.
segments.zh: 虽然它并不是全新的、刚诞生的。而且她想就此谈一谈。

segments.en: And it was specific around lab-grown diamonds and what she'd hoped to do with the company and how she wanted to grow it and a partnership that we might, we may or may not be able to sort out.
segments.zh: 具体是关于实验室培育钻石，她希望用这家公司做什么，想如何发展它，以及我们可能、也许能或不能达成的合作。

segments.en: And I was really intrigued and discovered how little I really knew about lab-grown diamonds.
segments.zh: 我真的很感兴趣，也发现我对实验室培育钻石的了解少得可怜。

segments.en: And most of what I knew was generally what's happening here in this country.
segments.zh: 而我所知道的大部分，基本上就是这个国家正在发生的情况。

segments.en: And the price point that it had found its success.
segments.zh: 以及它找到成功定位的价格点。

segments.en: And that was kind of how limited I was. And then I met the person who runs the masterclass.
segments.zh: 那差不多就是我的局限。后来我遇到了主持大师课的人。

segments.en: She was pretty amazing. Well, talk to us about how the acceptance of lab-grown diamonds.
segments.zh: 她非常出色。来谈谈实验室培育钻石的接受度吧。

segments.en: Because I remember doing stories a few years ago and there were either limitations, there were costs involved in terms of the creation.
segments.zh: 因为我记得几年前做报道时，要么有限制，要么在制造方面涉及成本。

segments.en: And I know there is, to some extent, too, but how it has evolved.
segments.zh: 我知道某种程度上现在也有，但它是如何演变的。

segments.en: And because when I talk to most people who get engaged today, it's a lab-grown diamond.
segments.zh: 因为当我与今天大多数订婚的人交谈时，都是实验室培育钻石。

segments.en: Well, actually, 61% of the engagement around in the US won lab-grown diamond last year.
segments.zh: 实际上，去年美国61%的订婚戒指是实验室培育钻石。
